breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains the conflicting instruction, stating both 'Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift' AND 'Ensure the k-point grid is gamma-centered' in multiple places. The ground truth removed the gamma-centered requirement entirely, keeping only the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid. The agent repeated the original error rather than resolving it.
